---
title: "prueba"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false

colores <- colors(distinct = T) |> 
  stringr::str_subset("gray", negate = T)

estilo <- "color: black; border-radius: 4px; padding: 1px 4px; margin: 1px; line-height: 1.6;"
oscuros <- c("black", "blue", "blue2",
             "blue3", "blue4", "midnightblue", "navy", "slateblue4", "purple4",
             "firebrick4", "darkred", "deeppink4", "indianred4", "maroon4", "mediumpurple4", "sienna4", "tomato4", "darkgreen", "violetred4", "orangered4"
)

cuadritos <- purrr::map(
  colores,
  \(color) {
    shiny::span(
      color, 
      style = paste("background-color:", gplots::col2hex(color), ";",
                    estilo,
                    paste("color:", ifelse(color %in% oscuros, "white", "black"))
      ),
    )
  })

shiny::tagList(cuadritos)
```
